description: The figure is a donut-style pie chart showing the distribution of “Stimuli Type” for Agency B, with 7 labeled categories totaling 38 items; the largest slice is “External News Article (15/38)” in dark green (about 39%), followed by “Draft/Other (9/38)” in dark red (about 24%), “Email (5/38)” in dark brown/maroon (about 13%), “Press Release (4/38)” in yellow-gold (about 11%), “Interview (2/38)” in dark navy (about 5%), “Organizational Report (2/38)” in muted purple (about 5%), and “Intra-agency news article (1/38)” as a small orange slice (about 3%). Category labels with counts in the form “(x/38)” are placed outside the ring, while the center of the donut contains the bold text “Stimuli Type”; there is no separate legend, no percentage text printed inside slices, and no slices appear exploded or otherwise visually emphasized beyond their color and size. The slices appear arranged around the circle without an explicit numeric axis, with the largest green segment spanning much of the left side and the red “Draft/Other” segment on the upper-right.
